preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == int(len(A)) and 1 <= len(A) <= 1000 and all(c.islower() for c in A) for A in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != ''] and len([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != '']) % 2 == 0)
preconditions.description: Each string A and B in the input consists of lowercase alphabets and has length between 1 and 1000 inclusive. Input is well-formed with alternating A and B lines.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() in ['Yes', 'No'] for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line of output is either 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: all((any((s1 + s2) == (s1 + s2)[::-1] for s1 in [A[i:j] for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(i+1, len(A)+1)] for s2 in [B[k:l] for k in range(len(B)) for l in range(k+1, len(B)+1)]) if stdout_line == 'Yes') for A, B, stdout_line in zip([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != ''][::2], [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != ''][1::2], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, 'Yes' is printed if and only if there exist non-empty substrings s1 of A and s2 of B such that s1 concatenated with s2 is a palindrome.
